description: This Java class 'Injector' provides a lightweight dependency injection mechanism for Android activities, specifically for injecting views annotated with @InjectView. It uses reflection to find annotated fields and assign views obtained via findViewById.

classes.name: Injector
classes.description: A class that performs view injection into an Activity based on @InjectView annotations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to obtain an Injector instance for a given Activity.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Performs injection of all fields annotated with @InjectView by calling findViewById and assigning the views.
